description: Fixed schooling, experience and wages for comparing linear and quadratic log-wage profiles.
source: Original synthetic OpenEconometrics teaching data; not real observations.

columns.name: education
columns.description: Completed years of schooling between 10 and 18.

columns.name: experience_squared
columns.description: experience multiplied by itself; must change together with experience in profile calculations.

columns.name: log_wage
columns.description: Natural logarithm of hourly wage measured in the stated currency unit.
columns.unit: Natural log of hypothetical currency units per hour

columns.name: hourly_wage
columns.description: Hourly pay; equals exp(log_wage) and is strictly positive.
